name: railvoy-monorepo
description: RailVoy — Intelligent Railway Reservation & AI Decision-Support Platform (Sem-3 Mini Project)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend dev" "cd ai_service && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload"
